history.summary: IDENTITY FLAG: 'Jagdambe Temple, Barmer' is AMBIGUOUS - several shrines in and around Barmer city carry the name (Old Jatawas Chohatan Road; Barmer-Sindhari Marg, Kurla; Bhadkha; Neebri Balera). This file documents the most-established one, the Jagdamba Mata Temple on Old Jatawas Chohatan Road, Barmer (listed with phone +91 84419 89863 and 4.4/100 reviews, ~2 km from the city centre). No published history or founding date exists for this temple (verify). COORDINATE FLAG: 25.742294, 71.395819 comes from a maps listing of this specific temple (not a geocode match - verify). town_description: Barmer is a historic Thar Desert city in western Rajasthan, known for wood carving, block printing, carpets and folk music, with a cluster of Devi shrines in and around the city.
